newsitem.title: FRANCE: MATIF rapeseed futures volume at record in October.
newsitem.headline: MATIF rapeseed futures volume at record in October.

text.p: MATIF rapeseed futures hit a record volume of 9,794 lots in October, the French futures exchange said in a statement on Tuesday.
This translates into some 489,700 tonnes of grain on the physical market, it said.
Volume jumped by 103.5 percent over the previous month and 118.5 percent over October 1995.
Daily volume stood at 426 lots in October 1996.
When MATIF launched the contract on October 28, 1994, it set a daily volume of 500 lots to ensure success.
Open positions at end-October reached a record 5,198 lots, up 161.3 percent from last year.
MATIF linked the good performance of the contract to strong activity on the physical market and to the exercise of option and premium contracts.
